column3: SisSis
Why haven't you played that godly game?
I told you I don't have the time to.
Just how slow are you? You should be able to complete it in about two evenings.
I don't feel like devoting two nights to games!
Isn't that all your fault because you haven't been playing at all?
I actually introduced something interesting to you! Why are you wasting somebody's good intentions?
You might think they're good intentions, but it's additional pressure for me.
No, there are deep circumstances behind this...
Besides, I still can't believe this.
I may not know your tastes, but you're wasting 1/3 of your life by not playing "SisSis"!
Are you aware of that?
I don't get it at all! Nor do I want to!
Y-You don't want to...? You don't have to take it that far!
Crap...! Did I go overboard?
But it's true that I don't have the time to play...
In short, it doesn't go along with my interests.
Hmph! That's because your level of comprehension is too low!
...Yeah...
Don't just shrug me off! I'm serious about this!
I-It's true that she's being serious in her own way.
That half-hearted response was a mistake...
Then, I'll order you once more.
O-Order, you say?
You must complete both routes before tomorrow morning. And also write a 30-page essay on your impressions.
You! Didn't you just say completing it requires at least two nights?!
The point is, this is a question of motivation.
It's absurd!
I mean, with the deadline approaching, shouldn't you hurry up rather than complain?
Essay?! No way!
You just thought it's impossible, didn't you? And that's why you can't do it.
Isn't that the same to admitting to your loss at the very beginning?
This isn't about winning or losing!
Ah, for your information, Wiki is prohibited.
If you dare to check the Wiki, I'll call you a Cheating Bastard.
What's that?!
Anyway, this game will make you shed tears; tissues are essential.
I wonder when will I really take the initiative to play it...
Wh-What's with that bad naming sense...
If you don't want it, then do it. Okay? Okay?
The important thing isn't whether you can do it or not!
To play or not to play?
Just do as you wish...
So? Will you play? Will you not? Which one is it?
